# ScienceGate

> > ScienceGate connects researchers with the right journals through intelligent matching across 86,000+ publications from major academic publishers.

ScienceGate is a research discovery platform that helps academics find and submit their work to appropriate journals. The platform integrates with major publishers including Elsevier, Springer, Wiley, SAGE, IEEE, and Emerald, and follows publication ethics standards set by COPE.

## Key Topics

- Journal Finder
- Manuscript Submission
- Journal Discovery
- Publication Matching
- Research Tools
- Academic Publishing
- Journal Selection
- Elsevier
- Springer
- Wiley
- SAGE
- IEEE
- SJR Ranking
- H-index
- Publication Ethics

## Core Tools

- [Journal Finder](https://www.sciencegate.app/journal-finder): Intelligent matching tool that connects research articles to 86,396 journals across major publishers including Elsevier, Springer, Wiley, SAGE, IEEE, and Emerald
